name: Hotel Kennedy
description: This city hotel, nestled between Termini Station and the Basilica of S. Maria Maggiore, offers convenient access to major bus lines just 150 meters away. Established in 1963 within a historical 19th-century building, the hotel features three lobby areas perfect for reading, relaxing, or enjoying music. Guests can savor excellent coffee and other beverages at the bar or browse the small international library stocked with foreign books and city guides. Each well-appointed room includes an ensuite bathroom and double-glazed, soundproofed windows. This family-run hotel provides excellent value. In response to the COVID-19 pandemic, the hotel has implemented safety measures. Staff members wear face masks and gloves, maintaining a safe distance while providing a warm welcome. Hand sanitizer is available at reception and before entering the breakfast area. Guests can opt for a packaged breakfast box if preferred. The buffet features individually wrapped items for enhanced safety. All rooms are sanitized with certified products to ensure a comfortable and safe stay.
